QUOTE: The assembly path is gated by `MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`, which is defined only when `MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM` is set and the compiler is GCC-compatible (`__GNUC__`) or ARM Compiler (`__ARMCC_VERSION`).
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says MBEDTLS_CT_ASM is defined from MBEDTLS_HAVE_ASM plus compiler predefined macros (`__GNUC__`, `__ARMCC_VERSION`). It never says outright that the macro is derived rather than configured, but the mechanism is stated.
